g.text: Every lead scored for fit and for fraud before a call
Every order checked before it reaches the market
Statements reconciled; two people for each change
web form, or a plan from the analyzer
BigQuery ML scores fit; fraud signals score trust
Document AI checks the ID against the form
Gemini hears the call; each flag quotes a second
Gemini Pro writes it; every figure checked
a conversation with Gemini; rules set the band
Gemini, grounded with Google Search, maps shocks
Vertex AI Search finds the fact-sheet section
an ADK agent answers from her own figures
rules: proceed, warn, hold or block
Flash explains it, never changes it
Cloud Scheduler starts it, 5:15 pm ET
Document AI or CSV; Gemini reads narrations
an ADK agent, after the rules
AI step: Gemini, BigQuery ML, Document AI, Vertex AI Search or an ADK agent
